categories.main_business_segments: Dongguan DingTong Precision Metal Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and sales of high-speed communication connectors and automotive connectors and their components. The company serves key sectors including telecommunications, data centers, servers, and new energy vehicles, focusing on products like backplane connectors, I/O connectors, copper cable connectors, and various automotive connectors such as control system connectors and high-voltage connectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision mold design and development, stamping, injection molding, and automated assembly processes. It emphasizes high-precision manufacturing, miniaturization, high-speed data transmission technologies (up to 224G and 448G), and thermal management solutions including liquid cooling. R&D focuses on improving signal integrity, heat dissipation, and product miniaturization, supported by a strong patent portfolio and continuous innovation in connector design and production automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading connector manufacturers such as Amphenol, Molex, TE Connectivity, and AVIC Optoelectronics, as well as major automotive brands like BYD, China FAW, Changan Automobile, and suppliers in the new energy vehicle sector. The company’s products are used in large data centers, servers, 5G base stations, and electric vehicles, targeting markets driven by AI, 5G, and new energy automotive growth.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing and R&D centers in Dongguan, Henan, and Changsha, and has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Malaysia. It serves both domestic and international markets, with export sales accounting for over 30% of revenue. The company is expanding its presence through regional marketing centers in key Chinese cities and leveraging its Malaysian subsidiary for global customer support.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dongguan DingTong Precision Metal Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of connector components and assemblies. It supplies connector parts to leading module manufacturers who integrate these into final connector modules for end customers in telecommunications and automotive industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-speed communication connectors and automotive connectors, focusing on advancing transmission speeds (112G, 224G, 448G), thermal management technologies, and product miniaturization. It invests heavily in developing new products for AI, 5G, and new energy vehicles, including battery management system components and high-voltage connectors. The strategy includes expanding automated production, enhancing technical collaboration with customers, and increasing patent filings to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-speed communication connectors, automotive connectors, precision molds, and related components. The company operates on a direct sales model, fulfilling customer orders based on contracts and purchase agreements, with revenue recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global connector manufacturers such as Amphenol, Molex, TE Connectivity, and AVIC Optoelectronics. It positions itself as a key supplier to industry leaders and a growing player in the new energy vehicle connector market. Its competitive advantages include advanced precision manufacturing, strong R&D capabilities, and stable long-term customer relationships, enabling it to maintain a leading position in the domestic connector component market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, representing a 51.12% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 110.34 million, up 65.74%. Total assets reached RMB 2.18 billion, with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations. The company has shown strong growth driven by increased demand in communication and automotive sectors, supported by significant R&D investment and expanding production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, high-performance connectors with advanced transmission speeds and superior thermal management, catering to demanding applications in AI, 5G, and new energy vehicles. Its integrated mold design and manufacturing capabilities, combined with automated production and strong quality control, provide customers with reliable, customized solutions. The company’s commitment to innovation, stable customer partnerships, and comprehensive service enhances its competitive differentiation in the connector industry.
